item.title: Morning news brief
item.description: Primary results show Democratic Party divisions, new inflation report may allow the Fed more time, and rescue teams are working on ongoing operations.

item.title: New indictment alleges Nick Reiner was lying in wait before killing his parents
item.description: A grand jury indicted Nick Reiner on murder charges for the deaths of his parents, Rob Reiner and Michele Singer Reiner, adding allegations of lying in wait.

item.title: U.S. ambassador calls settler siege of Palestinian homes a 'horrific act of terror'
item.description: U.S. Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee condemned Jewish settlers for besieging the home of an American Palestinian family, calling it a horrific act of terror.

item.title: Sailors and families remain in limbo over possible return to Middle East
item.description: Sailors and their families evacuated from U.S. bases in the Middle East months ago are still waiting for military decisions about their future.
